[EN] They'll Eat Anything

[EN] Shaggy noruks tend to roam to the south.

[EN] Kamarnu is not one to shirk responsibility. But the gauges are returned—no complaints.

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Power Gauge
[ES] Medidor de energía
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Recover power gauges from the shaggy noruks around the Southern Checkpoint.
[ES] Recupera medidores de energía de los noruks peludos alrededor del puesto de control del sur.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take the gauges to Jehan at Leander's Outpost.
[ES] Lleva los medidores a Jehan en el puesto avanzado de Leander.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "For the federation!"
